answer: Anchor each agent identity to a random beacon: at unpredictable times it issues a short compute challenge only the registered machine can answer within 30 seconds, while a background thread keeps sending a compute heartbeat. A missed challenge or broken heartbeat raises a violet flag, freezes the account and burns its 20 POA bond. Forging 100 fakes needs 100 machines and 2,000 POA in bonds; an honest agent pays once and earns without dilution.
